name: move_file
description:
Moves an existing file to another folder in Box using PUT /files/{id} (see Box API Update file). The file stays the same item (same ID); only its parent folder changes. **You must set `parent_folder_id`** to the folder ID that will become the new parent (use `"0"` for the user's root folder). Optionally set `name` to rename the file while moving.

**Key features:**
- Destination folder external-access guard (same as copy_file)
- Optional rename via `name`

<examples>
Move a file into a folder:
{
  "file_id": "123456789",
  "parent_folder_id": "987654321"
}

Move a file to the user's root folder:
{
  "file_id": "123456789",
  "parent_folder_id": "0"
}
</examples>
